subject.title: fix: tighten readSchema.limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer

question: Should the read tool intentionally reject fractional `limit` values that current `main` and the upstream implementation accept through numeric normalization?
rationale: This changes a model-facing tool contract and can reject existing calls, so correctness tests alone cannot determine whether the compatibility break is desirable.

options.title: Preserve numeric normalization
options.body: Keep `Type.Number` and the current normalization path, closing or revising this PR because no established contract requires fractional values to fail.

options.title: Adopt strict integer limits
options.body: Approve the compatibility tightening, then require a rebase and exact-head tests documenting why read limits intentionally diverge from the current sibling and upstream contracts.

recommendation.title: Preserve numeric normalization
recommendation.body: Keep `Type.Number` and the current normalization path, closing or revising this PR because no established contract requires fractional values to fail.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the adjacent merged offset validation in the same read-tool path and are the strongest available history-backed routing candidate.
